cursor.description: Absent on the last page, and once the pages are 200 files deep.

fileCount.description: How many files the query found in all, of which files are the best.

languages.description: The languages of the files found, counting those its lang: filters leave out, most files first: of the first 1000 files at most. The first page alone lists them.

matchCount.description: How many matches the query found in all.

repo.description: Only this repository's dev.knotless.repo record, its authority a DID or a handle.

limit.description: The most files to answer with.

cursor.description: How many files the pages before held. The pages go 200 files deep at most.

main.description: Searches the default branches of the public repositories an appview indexes, in Zoekt's query language: words and quoted text as substrings, ignoring case unless the query holds a capital, a regular expression between slashes, and filters such as file:, lang: and case:yes. No authentication needed. Repositories taken down are left out. An appview that searches no code answers 501.

content.description: The lines, each after the first following a newline, with no newline at the end.

highlights.description: What its highlighting paints over the content, encoded as dev.knotless.getFile's ranges are, the lines read alone. Absent for a language with no grammar.

chunk.description: Lines of a file holding matches, with a line on either side.

byteEnd.description: Where it ends, in UTF-8 bytes, exclusive.

byteStart.description: Where the match starts on the line, in its UTF-8 bytes.

range.description: A match, or the part of one on one line.

path.description: The file's path in the repository's default branch.

chunks.description: Runs of lines holding matches, in order. Empty when only the path matched.

commit.description: The commit of the default branch that was indexed, whose lines these are: a page of the file links there, as the branch may have moved since.

language.description: What it is written in, as Zoekt names it from its extension or contents.

fileView.description: A file the query found, with the lines around what it found there.

name.description: As Zoekt names it, and lang: takes it.

color.description: Its color, as linguist has it. Absent for a language with none known here.

languageCount.description: A language files were found in, and how many.

description: Searches the code of the public repositories an appview indexes.
